  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: persist_orch_group_failures puts the issue title, which the issue author controls, into `grouped_items`; invoke_stall_judge then merges it into `diagnostics` and echoes it under a plain `=== STALL DIAGNOSTICS JSON ===` header, with no UNTRUSTED fence, no `UNTRUSTED_DATA:` label and no injection guard in prompts/mode-judge-stall-recovery.txt.
  WHY: The cleanup (strip control characters, drop `<!--`/`-->`, break up `===`, cap at 120 chars) and JSON encoding do not neutralise natural-language instructions in the title, so a crafted title can steer the judge towards mutating actions such as close_and_reissue or attempt_merge; severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated NIT (bot-written titles, enum-restricted output) and also notes that `#N`/`@name` are not scrubbed, while minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated MAJOR, so the highest is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:20244-20267 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The untrusted grouped-item titles also reach the judge's semble query/prefetch path through `append_judge_semble_query_text "Diagnostics JSON:" "${diagnostics}"` (line 20266), so they become part of the judge-context text with no untrusted marking.
  WHY: This breaks the plan's rule that per-issue untrusted data is appended only after the cacheable static prefix and memory, and it widens the model-input scope with no gate or boundary.
- scripts/persist_orchestrator.py:555-558 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `episode_ts[gh] = max(items[gh]["newest_ts"], items[owner]["newest_ts"])` uses the owner's newest journal entry as the duplicate-post threshold (checked in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19977-19980), so after post_state_comment fails, a later same-key failure by the owner makes the existing marker fail `>= $ts` and a second identical "Paused" comment is posted.
  WHY: The owner is not paused and keeps being retried, so the threshold moves forward and partly undoes the duplicate suppression; both reviewers rated NIT; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputes the finding, saying the check runs only for members in `new`, so a repost needs a release and regroup, which counts as a new episode.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19843-19976 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]

  WHY: Nothing breaks at runtime, but the comments misstate the rule now in use (the newer of the member's and the owner's newest entry) and the map's shape, and a later edit that follows them could bring back the owner K->K2->K bug; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash gave this as a hardening item with no severity.

  WHY: This partly undoes the duplicate suppression; fix (about 8 lines in _newest_failure): use the start of the newest unbroken run of failures with the same key and take max(member_run_start, owner_run_start).
